meta.title: 03/04 Vietnam Vlog - They Said Finding Veg Food in Vietnam is IMPOSSIBLE. They Were Wrong.
meta.description:
Is Vietnam a paradise for vegetarians? 🇻🇳 I spent 30 days exploring the streets of Vietnam to find the best meat-free local eats! From the iconic Banh Mi to hidden gems, here are 20 foods you HAVE to try (and a few I'd personally skip)

In this ultimate Vietnam Food Guide for Vegetarians, I’m breaking down the myth that it’s hard to find veg food here. Whether you're an Indian traveller or just love plant-based food, this vlog covers everything from street food in Ho Chi Minh to traditional dishes in Hoi An. I'll also share tips on how to ask for 'Chay' (vegetarian) food so you never go hungry!

🍜 Local Vegetarian Food & Drinks I Tried in Vietnam as an Indian Veg Traveller 🇻🇳

🥖 Street Food & Meals
Banh Mi - Hanoi, Ha Giang, Cat Ba, Da Nang, Hoi An, Ho Chi Minh
Vegan Pho - Cat Ba, Ninh Binh, Da Nang
Vegetable Noodles - Hanoi, Ninh Binh
Fried Noodles - Tien Phat Restaurant, Ninh Binh
Bun Cha Chay (Vegan) - Chay TAM KHOI, Hanoi
Vegan Hot Pot - Ha Giang Loop
Mi Quang (Vegan) - Da Nang
Cao Lau (Vegan) - Quan Cao Lau Ba Le, Hoi An
Fresh Spring Rolls - Hoi An
Fried Spring Rolls - Ha Giang Loop
Banh Xeo (Vegan) - Hoi An
Fried Tofu - Ninh Binh

☕ Drinks & Desserts
Salt Coffee - Ha Giang Loop
Egg Coffee - Little Hanoi Egg Coffee, Ho Chi Minh
Coconut Coffee - Hoi An
Coconut Ice Cream - Cat Ba Island
Cassava Cake - Ha Giang
Grilled Banana in Sticky Rice - Chuoi Nep Nuong Vo Van Tan, Ho Chi Minh
Banh Chay (Dessert) - Che Muoi Sau, Hanoi 

🥂 Cultural Experience
Happy Water (Local Corn Wine) - Ha Giang Loop

🌱 Note for Vegetarian Travellers
In Vietnam, “vegetarian” can sometimes include fish sauce or meat-based broth.
👉 Look for “Chay” = Vegan-friendly food.

comments.author: @Tideo123
comments.text: I would imagine that finding veg food in Vietnam could be hard unless you are in a big city that can accommodate wide range of tourists. Vnmese people only eat veg foods in the Buddha celebration days. In general, Vnmese foods use meat to extract umami and for protein plus vegetables for vitamins add some herbs and spices to enhance taste and smell. If you can't find veg anywhere then you just order any dish in the menu then tell them not to put meat in the dish.
